Vitalisms II
December 3 (all day)
N101, ICA at NYU Shanghai
NYU Shanghai - NYC Events
Vitalisms II is an exhibition-as-experiment that continues a long-term research and education project on contemporary painting in China. Following the first chapter’s inquiry into the historicity of painting, we now turn toward a different question: How does value come into being through our encounters with painting? As the opening season of our new artistic research program Untimely Inheritances (2026–28), Vitalisms II considers inheritance as a condition we inhabit and reinterpret. Within the financial imagination, value is rendered calculable, comparable, and exchangeable. Yet value can also name artistic, historical, social, institutional, and affective relations.
